label: FishBase version 04/2025 (species and families tables, rOpenSci/rfishbase parquet mirror)
bibliographic_citation: Froese R, Pauly D (eds) (2025) FishBase. World Wide Web electronic publication, www.fishbase.org (mirror www.fishbase.se), version (04/2025). Parquet snapshot distributed by Boettiger C for rfishbase at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cboettig/fishbase.

distributions.description: species table (one row per valid species); sha256 equals the Hugging Face LFS oid
families table, used to attach Order and Class to each species

counts.description: data rows in the distributed file(s)
rows whose species, genus, family, order or class matches a listed taxon (a row can match several nested taxa)
slice taxa with at least one matching row

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled species accounts for all described fishes: maximum length, longevity, habitat (fresh/brackish/marine), depth range, vulnerability, with taxonomy to class.
role: species-level trait records for the listed fish taxa; the species table as a whole is the reference list for Darwin's 'fishes'

integrity.note: DOI checked through https://doi.org/api/handles/; sha256 computed on the downloaded file(s)

notes: FishBase has no DOI and no official bulk download; the rfishbase parquet mirror is the citable snapshot used here. Darwin's 'Ganoid fishes' are counted as the FishBase classes Chondrostei, Holostei and Cladistii.
